findings.title: Emit compiles the test file into dist, where `node --test` will pick it up
findings.why: `include: ["src"]` now has to cover `index.test.ts` for the type check. A real emit therefore writes `dist/index.test.js` and a `.d.ts` for it. `node --test` auto-discovers `*.test.js` files anywhere outside node_modules. After a build, `npm test` would run the tests twice, and the second run would use the compiled copies. Excluding `*.test.ts` from emit, or adding a separate tsconfig for the type check, would avoid this.
